x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change delegated-authority-check (REQ-DMR-008). The account, group and act keys that let another app ask whether an account holds an authority were added to bevoegdheidstoedeling (fragment 54); the rename to authority-delegation (fragment 86) did not carry them, so the copy dropped them and the check found nothing to grant. They are declared here on authority-delegation, unchanged. Properties only, so no schema version moves, as in 134-decision-authority-basis.

delegateUser.title: Delegate (account)
delegateUser.description: The Nextcloud account that holds this authority. Optional. Together with delegateGroup and acts it lets an app ask whether a person may perform an act; a toedeling without either stays documentation only.

delegateGroup.title: Delegate (group)
delegateGroup.description: The Nextcloud group whose members hold this authority, for an authority given to a function rather than a named person. Optional.

acts.title: Acts
acts.description: The act keys this authority covers, as the asking app names them (for example a decision type or a case type). An empty list covers no act: the delegated authority check never reads an empty list as 'everything'.
